glosses: To feel a prickling or mildly stinging sensation.

examples.text: My hands were tingling from the cold.
I got hit in the butt yesterday, and it still tingles.

For five minutes Pollyanna worked swiftly, deftly, combing a refractory curl into fluffiness, perking up a drooping ruffle at the neck, or shaking a pillow into plumpness so that the head might have a better pose. glosses: To cause to feel a prickling or mildly stinging sensation.

examples.text: Tingle your tastebuds with these exotic dishes.

glosses: To ring; to tinkle or twang.

examples.text: Sideways leaning, we sideways darted; every ropeyarn tingling like a wire; the two tall masts buckling like Indian canes in land tornadoes.

glosses: To cause to ring, to tinkle.

examples.text: Jackson, the butler, older of course, and altered he can see at a glance, opens the door almost before his hand is off the bell he has only gently tingled.

glosses: A prickling or mildly stinging sensation; frisson.
